decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD sits close to the established catalog, costs almost nothing to keep listed in a warehouse-backed shop of 60,000 items, and fits the strategy of broadening genres, so no shortfall is visible that would trigger problemistic search in a growing industry.

The illustrated release series builds on the label's core reissue competence and still has its own page; with industry turnover rising and no signs of distress, results are presumably satisfactory against aspirations and the firm can carry the series while it matures.
